identity.title: What Kind of Pokémon Are You?

leadText: What Kind of Pokémon Are You? is the name of one song that was in Pikachu's Jukebox and the Pokémon 2.B.A. Master CD. A slightly different version also was in Pokémon Live! and the Pokémon Live! CD. It lists the 15 types that existed in Generation I. A non-lyrical version is featured in the game Pokémon Puzzle League as the theme song for Erika.

It lists the 15 types that existed in Generation I. A non-lyrical version is featured in the game Pokémon Puzzle League as the theme song for Erika.

==Credits==
Lead vocals: Joshua Tyler
Rapper: Russell Velázquez
BG vocals: Russell Velázquez, Sharon Bryant, Kati Mac, John Loeffler
Guitar: Larry Saltzman
Co-produced and arranged by John Siegler

==Trivia==
The original airing of What Kind of Pokémon Are You? on Pikachu's Jukebox used the original first verse, but due to "grass" being mistaken for the word "ass", the DVD releases of Pikachu's Jukebox use the end of the third verse (with ) instead. This results in both Dratini and the type being mentioned twice, but no mention of the type.
can still be seen in its original, in the music video.
Also in the music video, the footage of Dratini and are from the banned episode EP035. Footage from the Professor Oak's Pokémon Lecture segments is also shown, specifically Oak pulling his computer's lever and the computer's display.
Sheet music for this song is included in , Pokémon Five-Finger Piano and Pokémon 2.B.A. Master: Recorder Fun!.
